screens.title: Today: the count of what needs the person in the title, one card with who asks, the feature and the answer, Later, the queue of the next things, Working now with the spend of today, the reminder to log time, the panels of the role, My work, Since you were away; the Ask bar in the top bar
Today, light theme

Library / Architecture: the reader opens on the picture alone, with the switch Picture, Both, Text and the Library back link; the diagram or picture fits the zoom frame at the first paint; a sideways gesture or a drag pans it, a pinch zooms it, Fit brings it back
Library / Questions: the register of open points, with the Library back link in place of the section switch

Plan / Timeline: the title gives the end date of the release; the sheet, the zoom Day, Week and Month, Dates and days off, Export and Send to the issue tracker; one card names the people with too much work and offers proposals with Apply and Rebalance; the Gantt chart of the sheet; the old Work / Plan address opens it

Flow: each feature once in five stages (Idea, Spec, Build, Review, Ready), the views Flow, List, Done and Health, the filter All, Needs me and Mine, and New feature; a card shows the title, who works on it and its state

Crew, Live: one row for each agent at work with the agent, the feature and its state, and the files and specs that it reads and changes; the filter At work, Ended, Files and Specs; the ref is the tooltip and Copy ref is in the menu of the agent; it replaces the Agents map, and the old address opens it

Code / Now: the files to commit with the commit box (Summary, Description, Write it for me, Commit), then the pull requests with a search, the filter All and Needs review, the open ones first and Merged and closed behind one button; two doors open the product health and the files
Library / Learn: the path, the glossary, the learning paths and the feeds, with the Library back link; the manual opens from the account menu, F1, the Ask bar or its chip in Library

Top bar: sidebar toggle, Back and Forward, the project name with the Projects page, the sync mark (branch, state of the repository, Sync with ahead and behind), the Ask bar, the Files and Terminal buttons, and the account menu
Projects: the page behind the project name of the top bar, with the open project, the projects opened before, New project, Open a local folder, Clone a repository and Import a project
Menu bar panel: the same things that need the person as Today, the spend, the runs with Stop, the agents switch, the sync, the project, and Open Shipyard
Library / Slides: an HTML deck in a sandboxed frame with Present and Export PDF; a Markdown deck is read only with Convert; the Library back link

Full assistant: the threads (new, rename, delete), the message box, then one bar with attach, the mode, the model and effort menu, the permission, the context ring and Send; the trace, the changed files with keep and undo, and the side and width of the panel
Setup / This project, Connections: the issue trackers and the code hosts of the project, behind a door with a back link; the MCP servers with their allow list picker are in This computer
Onboarding tour: six steps with a title, one sentence and a picture; opens once after the first project; Close, Back, Next, Done and Open the manual
Setup / This computer, Permissions: each OS permission with its state and one action, Allow all, and Replay the tour; the Get started steps are in Setup / Start

Setup / This project: the doors Connections, Tickets, Extensions and Health of this project, above the project form, the automation and the import; Health of this project has Check again and Fix all with an agent

Setup / Me, Look and layout: the Theme select (Light, Dark, OLED, System, System with OLED, imported themes), Theme files with Import and Export, a row for each imported theme with Remove, and the preview dialog

Crew / Recipes: each recipe and each agent role is a card with its step names and Edit; the editor shows each step as a card with the groups Who, People, How it works and Limits; Duplicate, Rename and Delete are in the More actions menu; the old Factory / Workflows address opens it

Setup / Me: the Language select (English, French, German, Spanish, imported languages), Language files with Import language and Export English, the Mark untranslated text switch when a language file is current, a row for each imported language with Remove, and the import dialog
New project: the five steps of the creator, the preview of the files and the start choice

Crew / Rights: the rights of each role and of each member by area, who Shipyard found, Ask to join, the move of the roles of this machine and the changes of rights; the members are on Crew, and the old Work / Team address opens Crew

Flow / Feature, Story: the page of one feature, with the stage line, the one action of the state, one question for its approvals, and the sections Story, Brief, Design, Changes, Checks and Chat; the Story shows the events in plain sentences, and all events, the requests and the live terminal open on demand; the old run address opens it
Flow / Done: each ended feature, newest end first, with search; a row opens the feature page

Crew / Spend: the spend and the success rate with the runs, their key and title, on the left; the budgets, each with Edit, and this computer on the right; the agents switch in the header; the old Factory / Usage address opens it
Today / Activity: the live runs with Stop and the sessions with Stop, as a view of Today (it replaces the Activity panel of the top bar)
Account menu: Setup / Me, Theme (Light, Dark, System), Manual, Shortcuts, What's new, Replay the tour
No project: one page for every place with Open a folder, Clone a repository and New project
First run: the role step with Continue, then the open-a-project step

Flow / Feature, Changes: the pull request of a feature with the header, the four tabs, the merge box and the conversation; the old pull request address opens it. the header with the state, the branches and the line counts, the four tabs, the merge box with Checks, Comments and Approvals and a Merge split button, the description, the conversation with threads, and the sidebar with reviewers, links and Cited by

Flow / Feature, Changes, Files changed: the file tree with a filter, Expand all, the viewed count, collapsed file rows with their counts, a thread and a pending comment under a line, and the pending review bar with Submit review and Discard
Flow / Feature, Changes, Submit review: the verdicts Comment, Approve and Request changes, the review text with Preview, and the list of pending comments
Shell: the place menu with Today, Flow, Plan, Crew, Library and Code, Setup at its foot, and one section switch at the top of the page
Today / News: the notifications by day with the action of each one, Mark all as read and Clear; the only list of notifications
Ask bar, open: the answer that names each blocked feature with its action, Go to with places and search results, Do with the actions and the prompts of the page, Open the full assistant
Flow / List: the features as rows with the same filter, the old Backlog and Changes addresses
Flow / New: what to build, the kind, three ways (an agent writes the spec, I write the spec, build now), and start from a ticket

Crew: the people as cards with their current work, role, days a week, skills and Over by or Has room; the agent roles as cards with their work and the count at work; the spend on open work with the limit for each feature; the recipes with Edit; the views Cards and Live and the agents switch; a person card opens the member page with Save and Remove from the team
Plan / People: each person with the load against the capacity of each week, the tasks with their dates, and the proposals for a person with too much work

Plan / Estimates: the estimate sheets with the costing and its seal; Ask an agent to estimate proposes Best, Likely and Worst with the assumptions for the selected tasks, with Accept, Discard and Stop; a sealed sheet turns the action off
Library: four doors (What it must do, How it is built, Why it is so, Learn and share), one chip for each page, and the waiting items first (open questions, decisions that wait); no section switch
Library / Reports: one card for each report with Export, Fill the form or a link to the page that holds it, and the Format choice (All, Word, Excel, Picture)
Library / Dashboards, Build a tile for me: what the tile must show, the budget, Build and Stop, then the Proposed tile with Accept and Discard
Setup / Start: the guided start with each step of Get started, one question at a time with Skip, and three doors to This project, This computer and Me, each with one state line

Setup / This computer: the doors Agents and rules, Outside agents, Health of this computer and Logs and feedback, above the AI tools, the model providers, the MCP servers, the certificates and the permissions
Setup / Me: the theme, the language, the role, the terminal, the default agent and the notifications, with one door to Look and layout
Code / Terminal: the command line of the project as a section of Code; the Terminal button of the top bar opens the same in the drawer
Flow / Health: the title counts the gates to fix, the gates and the scanners show for every role, and Run and Set up are off without the right
Flow / Feature, Checks: the row Impacts on other code opens the impacts of the change inside the section, with a back button
Plan / Time: the time sheet of the person by day, with a duration, a note and a ticket, and the send of a worklog to the issue tracker; the old Work / Time address opens it

Crew / Sessions: the agent sessions with runner, model, run, state and tokens, the totals in the last row, Active and Previous, Open in terminal, and the agents switch; the old Factory / Sessions address opens it
Library / Diagrams: the diagrams of the project, the picture first with the switch Picture, Both, Text, and the Library back link
Library / Decisions: the decisions with their status, the plain form first and the text on demand; a proposed decision waits on the door Why it is so
Library / API: the API descriptions of the project in a reader, with the Library back link
Library / Data: the data models of the project as a picture first, the text on demand
Library / Network flows: the flow matrix of the network calls with its export
Library / Screens: the screens of this registry with their picture, their artifacts and the Figma link
Library / Specs: the capabilities with their requirements in the plain form first, the text on demand
Library / Test plans: the scenarios of each capability with the requirement that each one tests
Library / Project rules: the constitution of the project in a reader
Library / Map: the map of the code as folders, with files and symbols on demand
Library / Handbook: the handbook pages of the project in a reader
Library / Manual: the guide of Shipyard by place; F1 opens the help of the current page
Library / Documents: the documents of the project with their export
Library / Dashboards: the tiles of the dashboard, the pinned tiles first, the edit mode and Build a tile for me
Code / History: the commits of the working branch with branch and tag labels and the picture of each author
Code / Branches: the local and remote branches with their actions
Flow / Feature, Brief: what the feature must do, with the ticket and the spec change of the feature
Flow / Feature, Design: the screens and the design files that the feature links
Flow / Feature, Checks: the checks of the feature and the row Impacts on other code
Flow / Feature, Chat: the talk with the agent of the feature
Setup / This project, Tickets: the ticket settings of the project
Setup / This project, Extensions: the extensions of the project
Setup / This project, Health of this project: the findings of the project and Fix all with an agent
Setup / This computer, Agents and rules: the AI tools, the model tiers and the rules
Setup / This computer, Outside agents: what an agent outside Shipyard can read and do
Setup / This computer, Health of this computer: the programs that Shipyard needs, with their state
Setup / This computer, Logs and feedback: the logs of the app and the feedback form
Close guard: the question before the app closes while agents work, with Stop them and close and Keep them working; it also names the unsaved drafts
